mapper.select: SELECT lbc.cfg_cost_id, MAX ( CASE WHEN lbc.TYPE = 'estimated' THEN lbc.id END ) AS id, MAX(CASE WHEN type = 'estimated' then main_id end ) as mainId, MAX(CASE WHEN lbc.type = 'estimated' then lbc.cost_value end ) as estimatedCost, MAX(CASE WHEN lbc.type = 'actual' then lbc.cost_value end ) as actualCost, cc.dict_cost_category as costCode, cc.cost_name as costName from tms_logistics_bill_cost_detail lbc inner join tms_cfg_cost cc on cc.id = lbc.cfg_cost_id and cc.is_deleted =false where lbc.main_id = #{id} and lbc.is_deleted = false group by lbc.cfg_cost_id, cc.dict_cost_category,cc.cost_name
